competing_explanation: The system may have retrieved the correct provision but failed to generate the citation due to a generation-stage error (e.g., hallucination or formatting constraint) rather than a retrieval-stage failure.
hypothesis_statement: The baseline policy-RAG system fails to cite the controlling provision because its retrieval mechanism lacks the semantic alignment or indexing specificity required to identify the specific legal clause as relevant to the query.
refutation_criterion: If the baseline system successfully cites the controlling provision in a majority of test cases, or if manual inspection reveals the provision was retrieved but incorrectly ranked due to a bug rather than a fundamental retrieval failure.
